scope: L05/L07 bounded retry before checkout for ordinary session and release-head metadata

prototypeReview.decision: Do not opt into queued lifecycle transactions. Preserve existing handling of genuinely uncertain execution.

fixture.name: shares a head between browser and CLI publication and delivers only committed releases
fixture.method: Real disposable Phoenix and PostgreSQL, same ordinary browser session before and after restart, with two controlled checkouts held and released on the restarted instance.
fixture.baselineFailure: Both reads exited before check-in. The fixture could not observe them waiting for the lifecycle checkout.
correctedChecks: With both connections held, a metadata request returned HTTP 503 within 1,500 ms. The pool queue stayed empty, the browser owner generation was unchanged, and the same session returned authenticated HTTP 200 after check-in.
When both reads were pending and the holders checked in within the retry window, session and release-head returned HTTP 200 and the expected committed sequence.
Existing signed publication, restarted delivery, and rollback assertions still passed.

limits: The isolated comparison addresses ordinary page overlap. The exact cause of the earlier 1.38-second response remains unproven. The candidate still needs independent successor review and hosted source binding.
